evidence.notes: Reference-pack coordinate is approximate and explicitly is not a surveyed building centroid.
Approximate synthetic rectangle whose area is close to the PWD-listed 9,962 sq ft (about 925 m²); it is not traced, independently measured, or validated as the real building footprint.
The Commonwealth Walkway describes three storeys; PWD lists three allowable floors. Exact present-day floor arrangement still needs direct review.

Dome center is now explicitly anchored to the provisional footprint bounds center to avoid the prior front-inset offset. Dome size and placement still require rectified imagery or measured plan evidence.
Three-bay arched facade is a procedural interpretation of reference photography; openings and mouldings are not survey-traced.
Assumed for massing only; no section drawing or survey height is available.
